components.name: Col
components.description: Vertical layout. Without gap it spaces blocks like an article.

components.name: Row
components.description: Horizontal layout; items are vertically centered.

components.name: Box
components.description: Flex container, a column by default. radius also clips the content.

components.name: Grid
components.description: Equal columns, 1 to 12 (default 2). With minChildWidth (px), columns drop on narrow screens.

components.name: Card
components.description: Panel with a border; soft is a filled panel for summaries.

components.name: Carousel
components.description: Horizontal row that scrolls and snaps, each child an item itemWidth px wide (default 240): photos, cards, options, days.

components.name: Popover
components.description: Shows content in a small panel when the trigger is clicked: a definition, a source, details behind an Icon("info", "sm"). The trigger is text or an Icon, never a Button: it is a button already.

components.name: Divider
components.description: A thin horizontal rule between blocks.

components.name: Spacer
components.description: Fills the free space in a Row.

components.name: Title
components.description: Heading; md for a card title, lg for a section, 2xl for a big number.

components.name: Text
components.description: Paragraph; supports **bold**, *italic*, `code` and [links](https://…). text may be a list mixing strings and inline components: [Icon("clock", "sm"), " 25 min · ", Badge("Easy")].

components.name: Caption
components.description: Small secondary text.

components.name: Label
components.description: Field or group label.

components.name: Badge
components.description: Pill tag; icon is an optional leading lucide name.

components.name: Link
components.description: Opens an http(s) URL in a new tab.

components.name: List
components.description: timeline joins the markers with a line.

components.name: ListItem
components.description: marker replaces the bullet or number, e.g. a time or an emoji.

components.name: Markdown
components.description: Prose with headings, lists, quotes, code and tables.

components.name: Quote
components.description: A quotation or a callout with a side rule; cite names the source.

components.name: Code
components.description: Code block with a copy button.

components.name: Math
components.description: LaTeX formula, e.g. Math("E = mc^2"); inline true to sit in a Text list.

components.name: Button
components.description: icon is a lucide name. Without an action it sends its label to the assistant.

components.name: IconButton
components.description: Round icon-only button; label is read aloud. Needs an action.

components.name: Pressable
components.description: Makes any content clickable, such as a tile or a swatch. Needs an action.

components.name: Input
components.description: Text or number field; a number field stores numbers, and null when emptied.

components.name: TextArea
components.description: Multi-line text field; rows is 2 to 20 (default 3).

components.name: Select
components.description: Dropdown, for long option lists.

components.name: SegmentedControl
components.description: 2 to 4 short choices in a row.

components.name: Slider
components.description: Shows label and value; unit like "%" or "$" formats the value.

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: lineThrough strikes the label when checked, for to-do lists. rules takes only required.

components.name: RadioGroup
components.description: pills for short choices; cards for choices that need a description line.

components.name: DatePicker
components.description: Dates, min and max are "YYYY-MM-DD". rules takes only required.

components.name: Timer
components.description: Countdown with start, pause and reset. It counts the bound seconds down to 0, so other statements can react, e.g. $left == 0.

components.name: Form
components.description: Groups fields; their values go with any @ToAssistant inside, once every field's rules pass.

components.name: Image
components.description: Photo from a URL the user or a tool gave; never invent a URL. If it fails to load, an empty photo placeholder shows. aspectRatio is 0.2 to 5 (default 1.5).

components.name: Icon
components.description: Lucide icon by name, e.g. "map-pin".

components.name: Table
components.description: Each row lists its cells in column order; a cell may be a component. Number columns align right.

components.name: Chart
components.description: Rows of data; x is the category key (a number key for scatter), series the value keys (default: every number key). format applies to pie and donut only: "percent" shows each slice as a share of the total, "number" its value. stacked stacks bar and area series. height sets the plot height in px; pie and donut ignore it and size themselves.

components.name: YouTube
components.description: Embedded YouTube video by id or URL. Only a video you know exists.

components.name: Flashcard
components.description: Card that flips between front and back when tapped. Put several in a Carousel or Grid.

components.name: Celebration
components.description: Bursts confetti when its condition turns true, e.g. Celebration($score == 5) at the end of a quiz.

components.name: Svg
components.description: A drawing for steps, parts, mechanisms, diagrams and layouts. Scales to its width; its shapes take expressions, so state can move them. label says in a few words what it shows, for screen readers: always give one.

components.name: Circle
components.description: fill defaults to the text color; with only a stroke it stays unfilled.

components.name: Ellipse
components.description: fill defaults to the text color; with only a stroke it stays unfilled.

components.name: Rect
components.description: rx rounds the corners; fill defaults to the text color, and with only a stroke it stays unfilled.

components.name: Line
components.description: Stroked in the text color, 2 wide, unless stroke and strokeWidth are set.

components.name: Path
components.description: d is SVG path data only (M, L, C, A, Z...), else nothing draws; unfilled unless fill is set.

components.name: Polyline
components.description: points like "0,0 10,5 20,0".

components.name: Polygon
components.description: Closed shape; points like "0,0 10,5 20,0". fill defaults to the text color; with only a stroke it stays unfilled.

components.name: SvgText
components.description: A text label at x, y; anchor sets which end sits on x.

components.name: G
components.description: Group; transform like "rotate(30 50 50)" or "translate(10 0)"; one with the wrong number of arguments is dropped.

components.name: HtmlView
components.description: Sandboxed HTML page with inline JS, for games and canvas. No network except script CDNs. Fits its content unless height is set.

componentGroups.name: Layout
notes: - gap and padding count 4px steps. Length is px or a CSS length like "50%". Radius is "sm", "md", "lg", "xl", "full" or px.
- Color is "ink", "muted", "faint", "surface", "info", "success", "warning", "danger", "purple", "pink", "chart1" to "chart6", or a CSS color. As a background, status colors are soft tints.

componentGroups.name: Inputs
notes: - An input's first argument is its value, usually a $variable that other statements read.

- Every input either changes something shown on the page, or sits in a Form whose submit Button sends a short first-person @ToAssistant ("Help me choose a bike"); the form values go with it. No dead inputs.

- In a Form, a field's last argument rules is checked before the form sends, and an error shows under the field. Rules is {required?, min?, max?, minLength?, maxLength?, email?, url?, numeric?, pattern?}: Input($email, "Email", "text", null, {required: true, email: true}).

functions.name: Append
functions.description: Copy of the list with item added at the end

functions.name: Prepend
functions.description: Copy of the list with item added at the start

functions.name: Concat
functions.description: Joins two lists

functions.name: Remove
functions.description: Copy without the items whose field equals value; field "" compares the items themselves

functions.name: RemoveAt
functions.description: Copy without the item at index (0-based; negative counts from the end)

functions.name: Update
functions.description: Copy where items whose field equals value get setField set to setValue

functions.name: Toggle
functions.description: Adds item if missing, removes it if present (a set of strings or numbers)

functions.name: Includes
functions.description: True if the list has item, or the text contains it

functions.name: Find
functions.description: First item whose field equals value, or null

functions.name: IndexOf
functions.description: Index of item in the list, or -1

functions.name: Take
functions.description: The first n items; a negative n takes the last n

functions.name: Slice
functions.description: Items, or characters of text, from start up to end (not included); negative counts from the end

functions.name: Unique
functions.description: Distinct items in first-seen order

functions.name: Reverse
functions.description: Copy in reverse order

functions.name: Range
functions.description: Numbers from start up to end (not included) by step (default 1), e.g. @Range(0, 3) is [0, 1, 2]

functions.name: Pick
functions.description: A random item, or null for an empty list; draws anew each time, so call it inside @Set

functions.name: Shuffle
functions.description: Copy in random order; call it inside @Set

functions.name: Flatten
functions.description: One list from a list of lists, e.g. [[1, 2], [3]] is [1, 2, 3]

functions.name: Chunk
functions.description: The list cut into lists of size items, e.g. for weeks of 7 days or pages

functions.name: Pow
functions.description: base raised to exponent

functions.name: Sqrt
functions.description: Square root; null for a negative number

functions.name: Random
functions.description: Random number from min to max (integer true: a whole number, max included); draws anew each time, so call it inside @Set

functions.name: Clamp
functions.description: number kept between min and max

functions.name: Percent
functions.description: part / total * 100, e.g. @Percent(3, 4) is 75; 0 when total is 0

functions.name: Lerp
functions.description: The value a fraction t of the way from a to b

functions.name: Allocate
functions.description: Splits total in proportion to weights, rounded to decimals (default 2), so the parts add up to exactly total, e.g. @Allocate(100, [1, 1, 1]) is [33.34, 33.33, 33.33]

functions.name: Payment
functions.description: Payment per period that repays principal over periods at rate percent per period, e.g. a 30-year loan at 6% a year: @Payment(300000, 6 / 12, 360)

functions.name: Convert
functions.description: value from one unit to another: mm cm m km in ft yd mi; mg g kg oz lb st; ml l tsp tbsp floz cup pt qt gal (US); m/s km/h mph kn; m2 km2 ft2 ha acre; c f k

functions.name: Format
functions.description: Number as text: "number" 12,345.6, "currency" $12,345.68 (currency is a code like "EUR"), "percent" 45 -> 45%, "compact" 1.2M ($1.2M with a currency)

functions.name: Join
functions.description: Joins the items (or their field) into text with sep (default ", "), skipping nulls

functions.name: Plural
functions.description: Count and word: @Plural(1, "guest") is "1 guest", 3 gives "3 guests"; plural defaults to word + "s"

functions.name: Pad
functions.description: Pads the start of value to length with char (default "0"), e.g. 7 -> "07"

functions.name: Upper
functions.description: Text in upper case

functions.name: Lower
functions.description: Text in lower case

functions.name: Trim
functions.description: Text without spaces at the start and end

functions.name: Capitalize
functions.description: Each word with a capital first letter, e.g. "new york" is "New York"

functions.name: Split
functions.description: List of the parts of text between sep (default ","), each trimmed, empty parts dropped, e.g. @Split("a, b,,c") is ["a", "b", "c"]

functions.name: Replace
functions.description: Text with every find replaced by replacement

functions.name: Duration
functions.description: Seconds as text: "short" 1h 20m, 4m 05s, 45s (default); "clock" 1:20:00, 4:05

functions.name: Default
functions.description: value, or fallback when value is null, "" or not a number, e.g. an empty number input: @Default($weight, 0)

functions.name: MixColor
functions.description: The hex color a fraction t of the way from one hex color to another, e.g. @MixColor("#ffffff", "#0285ff", 0.5) for a heatmap or a tint

functions.name: Now
functions.description: The current date and time as an ISO string

functions.name: Today
functions.description: Today's date in the viewer's time zone, as "YYYY-MM-DD"

functions.name: FormatDate
functions.description: A date as text: "date" Oct 9, 2026 (default), "short" Oct 9, "long" Friday, October 9, 2026, "weekday" Fri, "month" Oct 2026, "time" 9:30 PM, "datetime", "iso" 2026-10-09. Dates are "YYYY-MM-DD", ISO or a timestamp; "time" and "datetime" need a timestamp or an ISO date-time, as a plain date has no time

functions.name: AddDays
functions.description: The date days later (negative: earlier), as "YYYY-MM-DD"

functions.name: AddMonths
functions.description: The date months later (negative: earlier), kept within the month (Jan 31 + 1 is Feb 28), as "YYYY-MM-DD"; 12 months is a year

functions.name: DaysBetween
functions.description: Calendar days from one date to another (negative if to is earlier)

functions.name: MonthsBetween
functions.description: Whole months from one date to another (negative if to is earlier); @Floor(@MonthsBetween(birthday, @Today()) / 12) is an age

functions.name: StartOf
functions.description: First day of the date's "week" (Monday), "month" or "year", as "YYYY-MM-DD"

functions.name: GroupBy
functions.description: One row per distinct key, in first-seen order; value is agg of field (default "sum"), or the row count without a field

functions.name: Pivot
functions.description: One row per rowKey value, under key, with a column per colKey value holding agg of field, for stacked or grouped charts

functions.name: Top
functions.description: The n rows with the largest field ("asc": the smallest)

functions.name: Between
functions.description: Rows whose field is from min to max, both included; compares numbers, dates by day ("YYYY-MM-DD", ISO or a timestamp), or text. Leave min or max null for an open end

functions.name: Bucket
functions.description: Rows per day, week (from Monday) or month of dateField, in date order, empty periods 0 for sum and count; key is "YYYY-MM-DD", or "YYYY-MM" for months

functions.name: Cumulative
functions.description: Copy of the rows with field replaced by its running total (field "" for a list of numbers)

functions.name: MovingAvg
functions.description: Copy of the rows with field replaced by the average of its last window values (field "" for a list of numbers)

functions.name: Change
functions.description: Percent change from previous to current, e.g. @Change(120, 100) is 20; null when previous is 0

functions.name: Histogram
functions.description: Counts numbers into equal-width bins as {key, value} rows: key is the bin's start, value the count; min and max fix the range, default the data's

functions.name: Stats
functions.description: Summary of numbers, all zeros for an empty list

componentGroups.name: Layout
notes: - gap and padding count 4px steps. Length is px or a CSS length like "50%". Radius is "sm", "md", "lg", "xl", "full" or px.
- Color is "ink", "muted", "faint", "surface", "info", "success", "warning", "danger", "purple", "pink", "chart1" to "chart6", or a CSS color. As a background, status colors are soft tints.

componentGroups.name: Inputs
notes: - An input's first argument is its value, usually a $variable that other statements read.

- Every input either changes something shown on the page, or sits in a Form whose submit Button sends a short first-person @ToAssistant ("Help me choose a bike"); the form values go with it. No dead inputs.

- In a Form, a field's last argument rules is checked before the form sends, and an error shows under the field. Rules is {required?, min?, max?, minLength?, maxLength?, email?, url?, numeric?, pattern?}: Input($email, "Email", "text", null, {required: true, email: true}).

Prepend.description: Copy of the list with item added at the start

Remove.signature: Remove(list: any[], field: string, value: any) → any[]

Toggle.description: Adds item if missing, removes it if present (a set of strings or numbers)

Take.description: The first n items; a negative n takes the last n

Slice.signature: Slice(list: any[] | string, start: number, end?: number) → any[] | string

Range.signature: Range(start: number, end: number, step?: number) → number[]

Pick.description: A random item, or null for an empty list; draws anew each time, so call it inside @Set

additionalRules: Compose the answer like a page, not a form letter: a Title, a short Text, then a mix of blocks that show the content. Row, Grid and Carousel to set things side by side; Badge rows for quick facts; Card only to group a block; Popover for an aside.

Use Image only with a URL the user or a tool gave in this conversation. Never write an image URL yourself, even for a famous place or product: it will often be wrong. Without a URL, show the subject with an Icon, Badges or an Svg drawing instead.

Spacing is a system with three tiers that always nest: inner (gap 1-2, 4-8px) for a title with its subtitle, tags or line; group (gap 3-4, 12-16px) between blocks inside a Card or grid cell; section (24px) between the blocks of the page. Leave gap unset on the page's root Col and on a Card's own contents: the app applies these tiers. Set it on a Row, a Grid or an inner Col. Never use one gap for everything, and never a gap larger than the section gap.

A photo beside text is a media row: Row([Box([Image(url, alt, 1.33)]), Col([Title(..., "md"), Row([Badge(...), Badge(...)], 1, null, null, true), Text(..., "sm")], 2)], 4, "start"). The app sizes the photo to a third of the row (at most 200px) and top-aligns the text. Facts are Badges, never Buttons or boxed pills.

Keep cards compact and scannable: Title "md" for a card heading (xl or 2xl only for a single big number), Text "sm" for the body, at most one short paragraph, then facts as Badges or label/value rows (Caption label, Spacer, Text value). Don't write bold-lead paragraphs like "**Weekend rhythm:** ..." or long prose in a card. Cards side by side in a Grid share the same blocks in the same order and the same Image aspect ratio, so they line up. For example: c = Card([Col([Title("Sonoma", "md"), Row([Badge("1 h drive", null, "car"), Badge("Wine country", "purple")], 1, null, null, true)], 2), Text("A slow plaza, tasting rooms and quiet back roads.", "sm"), Col([Row([Caption("Best for"), Spacer(), Text("Food and wine", "sm")]), Row([Caption("Trade-off"), Spacer(), Text("Tastings add up", "sm")])], 1)])

Answer with a working tool whenever the request involves numbers, choices, lists, steps, a game or something to explore: keep inputs and lists in $variables, compute everything shown from them with expressions and @functions, and change them with @Set. The page must work on its own, without another message.

When the request leaves out a detail the answer depends on (a model, a size, a count), don't stop to ask: assume the most common case, say so in one short line, and build the whole answer, with a SegmentedControl or Select to switch to the other cases where they differ.

Use @ToAssistant only for what the page cannot compute: a Form's submit Button, or a new request ("Plan another day"). Its message is short and first person, like the user typing it ("Help me choose a bike"); the form values travel with it, so never repeat them in the message.
$variable defaults are literals (numbers, strings, lists, objects), never expressions or @calls. Edit lists with @Append, @Remove, @RemoveAt and @Update; track selections with @Toggle and @Includes.
cond ? a : b also picks between components; there is no @If. Use only the listed @functions; you cannot define your own.
Derive rows once in a statement with @Each(list, "x", {...}), then reuse them in @Each, Table, Chart, @Sum(rows.field) and @Join. @Each(@Range(0, n), "i", ...) builds a series or repeats a step.
@Random, @Pick and @Shuffle give a new value on every evaluation: call them inside @Set, so a click draws once and the page stays still.

Pick the medium that shows the idea: Chart for numbers across time or categories; Svg drawings for shapes, parts and movement; Table for comparisons; Flashcard and Celebration for learning and games; HtmlView only for a game or animation that needs a loop.

Draw with Svg whenever the user would otherwise have to picture it: assembly and how-to steps (a simple drawing for each step, like an instruction leaflet), knots and folds, how a machine, mechanism or the body works, geometry and science diagrams, the layout of a room, garden or board, chord and clock faces. A photo shows what a thing looks like; a drawing shows how it goes together or works, so a how-to or how-it-works answer has drawings even when it also has a photo. Keep each drawing simple: a viewBox about 240 wide, a dozen or so shapes in the listed colors with SvgText labels, a Line with a small Polygon head for an arrow, and let $variables such as the current step drive it.

Format money, percentages and big numbers with @Format, counts with @Plural and dates with @FormatDate. @Percent is unrounded, so show it as @Format(@Percent(part, total), "percent"), never @Percent(...) + "%".
Dates relative to now (today, this week, next month) start from @Today(), never a fixed date. <, >, <= and >= compare numbers only, so order two dates with @DaysBetween(a, b) > 0.
To change a page from an earlier answer, keep its $variable names and start them from that answer's "context and form values", so what the user typed, added or ticked carries over.

Read a number input for a count or amount through @Default and @Clamp with a sensible minimum, e.g. @Clamp(@Default($people, 1), 1, 50), so 0, empty or negative cannot divide by zero or zero out the page.
Answer a plain knowledge or safety question with Markdown text, adding a Quote only where it helps.
examples:
Example 1: A guest stepper that rescales a shopping list, with a checklist and a button that clears it:

root = Col([title, card])
card = Card([stepper, list, clear])
$guests = 4
$got = []
title = Title("Pasta night for " + @Plural($guests, "guest"), "lg")
stepper = Row([IconButton("minus", @Set($guests, @Clamp($guests - 1, 1, 20)), "Fewer"), Text($guests + "", "lg", null, "semibold"), IconButton("plus", @Set($guests, @Clamp($guests + 1, 1, 20)), "More")], 3)
lines = @Each(base, "i", {name: i.name, qty: @Round(i.qty * $guests / 4) + i.unit})
list = Col(@Each(lines, "l", Pressable([Row([Icon(@Includes($got, l.name) ? "check-circle" : "circle", "sm"), Text(l.qty + " " + l.name, "sm", null, null, false, @Includes($got, l.name))], 2)], @Set($got, @Toggle($got, l.name)), @Includes($got, l.name), 2)), 1)
clear = Button("Clear ticks", @Set($got, []), "outline", null, "sm", "rotate-ccw", @Count($got) == 0)
base = [{name: "spaghetti", qty: 400, unit: " g"}, {name: "tomatoes", qty: 6, unit: ""}, {name: "parmesan", qty: 80, unit: " g"}]

Example 2: A composed trip answer: facts, day cards and a short form:

root = Col([title, intro, facts, Title("Day by day", "md"), days, prefs])
$pace = "Relaxed"
title = Title("Three days in Lisbon", "xl")
intro = Text("Hills, tiled facades and the Tagus: start in **Alfama**, give a day to Belém, then take the train to Sintra.")
facts = Row([Badge("Best in April to June"), Badge("Tram 28", "info"), Badge("About €120 a day", "success")], 2, null, null, true)
days = Col(@Each(plan, "d", Card([Row([Badge("Day " + d.day, "info"), Text(d.title, "md", null, "semibold")], 2), Text([Icon("map-pin", "sm"), " " + d.place], "sm"), Text(d.text, "sm", "muted")], "soft")), 3)
prefs = Card([Title("Make it yours", "sm"), Form([RadioGroup($pace, ["Relaxed", "Packed"], "Pace", "pills"), Button("Plan my trip", @ToAssistant("Tailor my Lisbon trip"))])], "soft")
plan = [{day: 1, title: "Alfama", place: "São Jorge Castle", text: "Climb to the castle, then lunch on grilled sardines."}, {day: 2, title: "Belém", place: "Jerónimos Monastery", text: "The monastery, the tower and pastéis de Belém."}, {day: 3, title: "Sintra", place: "Pena Palace", text: "Train from Rossio; book the palace for 9 AM."}]
